item.tib: bsam gtan gyi 'dra ba las 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mchog rnams / 'di gsum gyi bye brag kyang mngon par 'byung ngo / de la bsam gtan thas cad pa'i nang na / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsam gtan dge'o zhes gsungs pa na / nga 'dir rnam grangs gzhan gyi bas/ gtan tshigs ni mi smos kyyis / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsam gtan gyi lung rnal 'byor chen po las / las su bsgom pa nyi tshe'i mdo tsam zhig bstan to
item.coloph: mi gnas ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo/ mdo tsam rdzogs so
